# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project overview
- This is a Vite React project for a photography studio brand named Swapna Photo Studio.
- Use functional React components and modern React patterns.
- Prefer clear, maintainable code with descriptive naming.

## Styling
- Use Tailwind CSS for all new UI work.
- Prefer utility classes over custom CSS when possible.
- Keep designs clean, elegant, and mobile-friendly.

## Testing
- Write and maintain Vitest tests for user-facing behavior.
- Prefer Testing Library for component tests.
- Validate changes with `npm test` when relevant.

## Code quality
- Favor small, composable components.
- Keep business logic separate from presentation.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies or over-engineering.

## Workflow
- Make changes incrementally and keep the app buildable.
- When adding features, ensure the relevant tests still pass.
- Follow the existing project structure and naming conventions.
